events.title: TSX Eyes Mixed Session On Geopolitical Uncertainty, Commodity Moves
events.description: Falling oil and precious metals prices threaten energy and materials stocks ahead of Tuesday's open. The S&P/TSX Composite Index closed Monday at 36,009.40, up 0.57%, supported by financials and tech.

events.title: U.S. Stocks Likely To Open On Cautious Note
events.description: U.S. stocks look headed for a cautious start on Tuesday, as investors await some crucial geopolitical news for directional clues. Easing concerns about inflation following another sharp drop in oil prices could aid sentiment.

events.title: UK Borrowing Overshoots Estimate
events.description: The UK government borrowing exceeded the government estimate in August as spending rose more than income, partly due to the impacts of inflation, data from the Office for National Statistics said Tuesday. Public sector net borrowing increased GBP 2.9 billion from the previous year to GBP 18.3 billion in August.

events.title: AutoZone Q4 Profit, Comps Rise; Sees Sales Growth In FY27
events.description: AutoZone, Inc., an automotive replacement parts retailer, reported Tuesday higher profit in its fourth quarter with growth in net sales and same store sales. Looking ahead, the company said it is well positioned for sales growth in fiscal 2027. In the pre-market activity on the NYSE, the shares were gaining around 0.53 percent.

events.title: U.K. Stocks Turning In Mixed Performance; FTSE 100 Up Marginally
events.description: U.K.'s equity benchmark FTSE 100 was up in positive territory a little past noon on Tuesday with stocks turning in a mixed performance as investors assessed the Middle East situation and looked ahead to U.S. President Donald Trump's speech at the U.N. General Assembly later in the day.

events.title: French Stocks Rise As Oil Prices Fall On Strait Of Hormuz Prospects
events.description: French stocks advanced Tuesday amid sharp oil price declines tied to potential Strait of Hormuz reopening. Brent crude fell 2.6% to $97.60 a barrel. The CAC 40 rose 0.55% as geopolitical developments influenced investor sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares End Slightly Lower In Volatile Trade
events.description: Indian shares ended slightly lower after a choppy session on Tuesday as oil prices fluctuated after declining for four consecutive sessions, and hawkish signals from Federal Reserve policymakers reinforced expectations of further interest-rate hikes by the U.S. central bank this year.

events.title: DAX Climbs As Oil Falls, Markets Eye Trump UN Speech
events.description: German stocks recovered from weak morning trading to gain 0.63% by midday Tuesday, buoyed by falling oil prices amid prospects for Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Investors awaited Trump's UN speech on peace initiatives.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower On Rate Hike Fears
events.description: Gold prices fell toward $4,300 an ounce on Tuesday due to expectations for additional Federal Reserve rate hikes.

events.title: Oil Prices Edge Lower In Volatile Trade
events.description: Oil prices traded lower in volatile trade on Tuesday amid hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Iran war and signs of recovering Saudi oil exports.

events.title: European Shares Slip Ahead Of Trump's UN Speech
events.description: European stocks were mixed on Tuesday after rising notably the previous day amid easing inflation concerns and hopes of a resumption in U.S.-Iran negotiations.

events.title: Yen Slides Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: Asian Shares Inch Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: Asian stocks followed Wall Street higher on Tuesday, with falling oil prices and softening U.S. Treasury yields helping underpin sentiment.
